content: Velopack is the modern successor to Squirrel.Windows for .NET auto-update, supports GitHub Releases as a source (GithubSource), but its packaging model creates an installer + Update.exe + versioned app subfolders (not a portable single exe) — conflicts with this project's standalone single-file exe distribution constraint per GitHub issue velopack/velopack#314 discussing exactly this friction for self-contained single-file apps.
